shutter_sequence: GetEvent.returnCb reads availableApiList from the event
if the list contains startRecMode and it was not yet called: StartRecMode.execute()
TakePicture.canExecute() returns false unless availableApiList contains actTakePicture
on error code StillCaturingNotFinished: if awaitTakePicture is available, calls awaitTakePicture instead of failing
